Structural extracts of live product pages, captured October 21, 2026 in a browser for the aggregator check (`lib/aggregator-signals.js`). Each keeps only what the check reads: the page's product data (images, descriptions and variants dropped), its cart and checkout links and add-to-cart controls, and its outbound buy links. The first line of each file names the page it came from. Lyst and Stylight are aggregators (both already on the blocked-store list); Farfetch, SSENSE and Grailed are real stores and marketplaces.
